create_paragraph_stats_pipeline: create a ParagraphStats pipeline to compute paragraph-level statistics on documents
calculate_short_paragraph_ratio: calculate the ratio of short paragraphs below a character threshold in a document
calculate_long_paragraph_ratio: calculate the ratio of long paragraphs above a character threshold in a document
compute_paragraph_duplicates: compute paragraph-level duplicate ratios using Gopher repetition filtering
extract_document_paragraph_stats: extract paragraph statistics including count, average length, and duplicate ratios from a document
